title: Pinning down the maximal quantum violation of the Guess-Your-Neighbour's-Input causal inequality
description: Certified bounds 0.622165901353 <= I_GYNI^max <= 0.622183755532 for the maximal violation of the GYNI causal inequality by process matrices of arbitrary finite dimension (previously [0.6219, 0.7592]). The upper bound comes from a new moment hierarchy for process-matrix correlations, certified at level 8 by an exact rational dual certificate; the lower bound is an explicit strategy verified in exact arithmetic. Both bounds, including the validity of the relaxation, are machine-checked in Lean 4 with Mathlib. The repository contains the paper and supplemental material (LaTeX source and PDF), solver-free verifiers, all certificates, the Lean project, tests and verification logs.
